summary.text: Sisay is the captain of the skyship Weatherlight, who searched for the pieces of the Legacy to destroy Yawgmoth, the Lord of the Wastes.

bio.text: Phyrexians raided her village and orphaned her, and she later set out to gather the Legacy, knowing only that it could kill the Lord of the Wastes.
She inherited the Weatherlight after its Zhalfirin family was killed, and gathered a crew that included Tahngarth, Gerrard and others influenced by the Bloodline Project.
Starke betrayed her to Volrath and she was abducted to Rath, which drew Gerrard and the crew there, where they freed her and retook the Legacy from Volrath.
The Weatherlight crashed on Mercadia, where Sisay gathered artifacts to repair the ship and helped lead the oppressed peoples to a change of regime.

When the Phyrexian Invasion began she helmed the Weatherlight in many battles until it crashed under attack by the Primeval Dragons, and she rejected Urza's plan to shatter the Legacy artifacts and Gerrard.
Gerrard, Urza and Karn merged to complete the Legacy and defeat Yawgmoth, and the Weatherlight sank near Urborg, after which Sisay, Tahngarth and Squee received a new vessel named Victory.

status.text: Sisay is dead by the later stories, which call her the late and original Weatherlight captain, an ancestor of Shanna.
